I bought this grill yesterday and assembled it in about an hour this morning. It's the perfect size----small enough to fit nicely on our deck, and big enough to grill for a large family!
My only concern is the side tables. They do not sit flat---parallel to the ground---when they are extended. They slant downward, and I worry about things sliding off them. They fold down perfectly. I have taken them apart three times and reassembled them, but nothing helps. Any suggestions?

Results.Title: Weber gas grill

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill recently when we moved from Maine to Ocala FL. It replaced a similar Weber grill which is now about 10 years old, and working well, that we left behind with our daughter. The amazing thing is that it is an improved version of our old Weber for the same price! It cooks evenly and is very versatile. I expect it to serve us for at least the next 10 years because Weber has replacement parts if needed. Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: Fantastic Grill, Great Value

Results.ReviewText: Good bbq. Lid not double hulled so let's heat out. Lid edges get very hot and are easy to accidentally touch. Starts up easy and fast. Wheels lock for safety in a deck. Good size for a smaller family or couple with limited room.
Results.Title: Good bbq at good price

Results.ReviewText: I’ve tried all kinds of grills. This one is the best. I love that one burner on low is the perfect smoking temp at 225
Results.Title: Spirit 2

Results.ReviewText: I am a first time user of a gas grill. I have used charcoal for 40+ years. So far the sheer convenience of gas is a plus! Constant heat that can be regulated without flare ups. Very easy to roll with the 4 casters.
Results.Title: First time gas grill user

Results.ReviewText: Bought a Weber for the first time in several years.  Glad I did.  Much better product for the money than any of it's nearest competitors.  Love the features of it.  Everything reachable form the front of the grill, heavy duty grills instead of steel, easy to clean, easy to start and use.  Good for two people but easily handle cookout for 24 people.  Biggest factor, made in the USA so replacement parts readily available.  I would recommend this grill over any other brand I have used.
Results.Title: Smart Choice for everyday use

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality. Even heat and well built. So much better than any of the cheap grills I owned.

Results.ReviewText: Our previous Weber gas grill was a genesis series. We had it for 15 years and it was great. We chose the Spirit E-210 this time based on size and lower price point. The new Genesis series are huge, and we have a small space on our deck. The materials used for the E-210 feel flimsy. Also, it does not heat evenly from front to back and there is no way to regulate the temperature.  I’m considering selling this one and upgrading.
Results.Title: Diff in quality compared last gen Genesis

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
